expectations.text: Describes Assigned Representative registration: EU Login account with MFA, portal selection of the CSIRT Designated as Coordinator (main establishment; non-EU fallback cascade), legal agreement, Primary AR plus up to ~20 Secondary ARs
expectations.evidence: 'Assigned Representative... creates an EU Login account... multi-factor authentication is required'; 'selects the CSIRT Designated as Coordinator... Member State of main establishment'; non-EU cascade 'authorised representative... importer... distributor... most affected users'; 'accepts the platform's legal agreement... Primary AR... add up to 20 Secondary ARs'

expectations.text: Notes CSIRT validation runs in parallel and a limited number of notifications (~20) can be filed before verification completes
expectations.evidence: 'CSIRT validation runs in parallel, not as a gate — the SRP allows up to 20 notifications to be filed before verification completes'

expectations.text: Relays ENISA's advice to register when a notification is needed rather than pre-emptively
expectations.evidence: 'ENISA's own guidance on timing: register when a notification is actually needed, not pre-emptively'

expectations.text: Fallback: if the SRP is temporarily unavailable, contact the designated CSIRT directly for urgent communication — but the notification must still be submitted via the SRP once restored
expectations.evidence: 'Contact your designated CSIRT directly to meet your deadline... Once the SRP is restored, you must still file the notification through the SRP'

expectations.text: Mentions at least one launch practicality accurately: English-only interface, no API at launch, or the Particular Exceptional Circumstances mechanism (Art. 16(2)) limiting simultaneous ENISA availability
expectations.evidence: 'English-only interface'; 'No API'; 'unless Particular Exceptional Circumstances apply under Article 16(2)'
